# PomoMons

> PomoMons is a free, browser-based Pomodoro timer with a creature-collecting
> game layer. After each completed focus session a wild food-themed pixel
> monster ("Pomomon") appears; you throw a tomato to catch it and build a
> collection. No account, no ads, works offline as an installable web app.
> All progress is stored locally in the browser.

## Key facts

- Free, no sign-up, no tracking cookies. Live at https://pomomons.io
- Works on desktop and mobile; installable (PWA) and usable offline
- Adjustable focus / short break / long break lengths (classic Pomodoro 25/5/15 by default)
- Every 4th completed focus session earns a long break
- 30 Pomomon forms across 16 base species (Pomodex #1-#30), including evolutions that trigger at level 16, 20 or 36
- Two rare variants: "shiny" (gold-tinted, 0.2% of encounters) and "dark" (near-black, 1%); 98.8% of encounters are normal
- Five flavour types: Savory, Sweet, Spicy, Sour and Bitter
- Player level, XP and collection are saved in the browser (localStorage + IndexedDB); an optional emailed backup code moves a collection between devices
- Caught mons can be set as a companion, or blended into a smoothie item that grants +1 level to another mon
- 8-bit synthesized sound effects (Web Audio API); no audio files
- Built with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no framework — and hosted on GitHub Pages

## Who it's for

Students, and anyone using the Pomodoro Technique for focus, who wants a light
game reward loop attached to their study sessions rather than a plain timer.
